provenance_note: Stored file on the Indian National Congress's own media store (Cloudinary account dkplc2mbj): a versioned upload URL whose ETag equals the MD5 of the body, with Last-Modified at the upload time. Cloudinary's edge answers query-string variants from its cache, so a cache-busting download is not an origin test; stability rests on the ETag match and on downloads at least 30 minutes apart. The researcher downloaded it at 12:19:39Z and again at 12:56:13Z on 25 September 2026, the Part C check downloaded it again at 13:02-13:03Z and again after 13:33Z, and this packet downloaded it again at 14:59Z, each time with the same byte count and SHA-256. This checked-in file is a derived factual extract, not a copy of the original response. Original response bodies, PDFs, images and page renders are not checked into this repository. Its own checksum is recorded separately in the packet.

scope_note: A stored file on the Indian National Congress's own media store, found through the INC press release of the Congress President's speech of 22 August 2019; the live inc.in release pages were used only as finding aids and were not hashed, because they are rebuilt per request.
